author: (Valenciennes, 1833)

note.en: The fangtooth is a small, dark deep-sea fish with huge teeth for its size. It lives from near the surface (juveniles) to thousands of metres and is known here by regional records only.
note.es: El pez colmillo es un pez oscuro y pequeño de aguas profundas con dientes enormes para su tamaño. Vive desde cerca de la superficie (juveniles) hasta miles de metros y aquí se conoce solo por registros regionales.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic
recWhy: No record on Costa Rica's Caribbean coast in the file (general range or Costa Rica only).
